subject: When I have a 360...
author: SUFFUR
body:
I have two, but did not bring one with me, as it's heavy and getting up at 5 am to play is wrong and my Dad would not approve since the connection is in his bed room, lol.

But not missing it yet, the sun is too nice, lol.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: A few times a week...
author: Aaboe
body:
😳  Though I am ashamed to admit it, I actually voted for "a few times a week" before perceiving that it was about *online* play. Um... right now and until sometime in the middle/end of next month I'm actually busy enough that the box doesn't get booted up (by me) more than a few times a week, and even then it's at most once a week that I go live...

But such is the life of being a small production company and the only person actually doing something there. *shrug* Hooray for 16 hour work days 7 days a week...

I'll be online again... sooner or later 😃

Aaboe

subject: With a busy life, Burnout is a good stress reliever
author: jwillisjr
body:
With a busy life, work and more.  I can only play a few times a week if im lucky.  I play 360 mostly, then on the road I play on psp.  This game is such a good stress reliever for me, you can get on and get off in like 10 minutes if you had to.

 

"The sleep of reason produces monsters" -Goya
